en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. My father, ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain, and Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan all narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from ‘Ali ibn Ismā’īl ibn ‘Isā, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Amr ibn Sa’īd Al-Zayyāt, from Dāwūd Al-Raqqi, who said:

I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)), Abal Ḥasan Mūsā (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)), and Abal Ḥasan (Imam Riďā (a.s.)) say: Allāh will make those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) on the Day of ‘Arafah return with hearts filled with certainty.
